route_a_native_dynamic_loader_hle.name: Native Dynamic Loader + HLE Runtime
route_a_native_dynamic_loader_hle.execution_mode: Native AArch64 hardware execution on host ARM64 (Cortex-A78/A55 on RG477M)
route_a_native_dynamic_loader_hle.audio_path: nn::audio / CRI Atom -> AAudio / OpenSL ES Bridge
route_a_native_dynamic_loader_hle.estimated_engineering_effort: Medium (Load NSO, implement ~429 nn functions, bind NVN to Vulkan)

route_b_static_recompilation.name: Static Recompilation / C++ Source Reconstruction
route_b_static_recompilation.execution_mode: Decompile binary -> generate C++ -> recompile with Android NDK
route_b_static_recompilation.codebase_scale: 119.76 MB uncompressed binary (94.4 MB .text machine code)
fatal_challenges: Indirect branch recovery in a 94.4 MB modern optimized C++ binary is undecidable
UE5 heavy use of virtual function tables, template instantiations, and LowLevelTasks lambdas cannot be accurately decompiled into structured C++ without type loss
Recompiled C++ code explosion (estimated 10-20 GB source) causing clang/gcc compiler OOM and extreme build times
Maintenance and debugging nightmare: cannot trace logic differences when bugs occur in auto-generated decompiler spaghetti
route_b_static_recompilation.verdict: REJECTED. Completely infeasible for a 120MB modern UE 5.6.1 title.

final_recommendation: Adopt Route A (Native Dynamic Loader + HLE Runtime). Implement minimal ELF loader, relocate via DT_RELR, bridge 651 dynamic symbols, and translate NVN to Vulkan.
